actual.descripcion: The police dog unit is called into action to chase a thief. The pursuit of a Range Rover leads the interceptors to a haul of stolen cars. And tensions run high when the cops are put on intruder alert.

One of the drivers gets a wake-up call when his friends lose a leg in a towing accident. Meanwhile, tow man Jamie realises that he has a new rival on the deathly Coquihalla Highway.

A car has broken down on the hard shoulder of the M6. PC Andy Doran is called in to support Highways, as they're unhappy with the driver's behaviour. When he arrives at the location, Andy quickly finds out why.

Steve responds to a burglary in progress, chasing a suspect through back gardens. Interceptors flood a housing estate searching for suspects involved in a shooting, and swoop on suspected shoplifters with a boot full of stolen booty.
Interceptor Steve is involved in a dangerous high-speed pursuit of a car stolen in a burglary. The fleeing driver ditches and runs, and the police chopper tries to keep him in their sights.

Inspector Anton Sullivan is one of six police cars involved in the pursuit of a vehicle that has failed to stop. The officers eventually manage to box the vehicle in, but the chase continues on foot as the passengers attempt to flee.
Phil Broughton pulls over a young lad in an old Vauxhall that's suspected of being on cloned plates. The biggest surprise of all comes when Phil discovers it's the driver's 15th birthday.
